scenes.text:
OCTOBER 1986. 2:13 AM.

The house is asleep. The only light in your bedroom is the green glow of a secondhand ACME PC/XT and the blinking LEDs of a 2400 baud modem you are still paying off.

You go by {handle} on the boards. Nobody there knows your real name. That is the point.

scenes.speaker: THE DEAD LETTER BBS
scenes.text:
*** 1 NEW PRIVATE MESSAGE ***

FROM: CASSANDRA
TO: {handle}

I've watched you poke around the phone company switches. You're careful. I like careful.

I need someone for a job that matters. But first, prove you're more than talk.

Ridgemont High still runs its admin box on a dial-up line. Get in. Pull the staff directory. Don't get traced.

- C

mission.title: Proof of Skill
mission.brief:
Ridgemont High's admin computer is barely protected. Scan the subnet, connect, crack the keypad lock and download staff_dir.txt. Tip: read files while you're in there.

NEW HERE? Commands: scan, connect <ip>, crack, ls, cat <file>, get <file>, dc. Watch the TRACE meter in your prompt. If it hits 100% you're caught.

10.0.1.20.name: RIDGEMONT-ADMIN
10.0.1.20.banner:
RIDGEMONT HIGH SCHOOL - ADMINISTRATIVE SYSTEM
UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS IS A VIOLATION OF DISTRICT POLICY

files.staff_dir.txt:
STAFF DIRECTORY 86/87
PRINCIPAL ......... R. VERNON
COMPUTER LAB ...... M. HALLORAN
GUIDANCE .......... J. FERRIS
NIGHT SYSOP ....... (contractor, Omnidyne Systems)
files.sysop_note.txt:
Halloran - Omnidyne's tech left their relay password taped to the lab terminal AGAIN. I've told them. 'nightowl' is not a secure password.
- Vernon

scenes.speaker: CASSANDRA
scenes.text:
Clean work. And you noticed the Omnidyne contractor, didn't you?

That's the real job. Omnidyne Systems builds 'network management software' for the phone company. Something in their lab is called BASILISK, and I need to know what it is.

options.label: "Who are you, really?"
options.text: CASSANDRA: Someone who used to work there. Someone who quit when they saw the spec sheets. That's all you get for now.

options.label: "What's it pay?"
options.text: CASSANDRA: 600 credits on delivery. More if what you find is as bad as I think it is. Mercenary. I can work with that.

options.label: "Why me?"
options.text: CASSANDRA: Because nobody at Omnidyne has ever heard of you. Yet.

mission.title: Basilisk
mission.brief:
Omnidyne has two machines on this exchange: a maintenance relay and the R&D mainframe. The mainframe's lock is nasty. Cracking it the hard way will light up the trace. Look for an easier way in.

Get project_basilisk.txt from the mainframe, and wipe access.log on the relay so they never know you passed through.

files.ops_memo.txt: To all night staff: the R&D mainframe operator password has been rotated per policy. New password is 'tiresias'. Please stop writing it on the whiteboard.
files.readme.txt: Relay 7 forwards maintenance traffic to RND-MAINFRAME (192.168.7.2).

files.project_basilisk.txt:
PROJECT BASILISK - INTERNAL ONLY

Phase 1: passive monitoring of all switched calls in the Mid-Atlantic exchange.
Phase 2: automated identification of modem users by line signature.
Phase 3: 'pre-emptive disconnection' of flagged individuals.

Status: PHASE 1 LIVE. PHASE 2 IN TESTING.

scenes.speaker: CASSANDRA
scenes.text:
...

Phase 2 is already in testing, {handle}. They can fingerprint a modem by the way it hisses on the line. Every hacker on the East Coast is about to be on a list.

Including you. Including me.

Stay off the big boards for a while. I'll be in touch.

END OF CHAPTER 1

The Job Board is still open if you want to earn some credits and upgrade your rig before Chapter 2.
